imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The beard-trimmer guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 108 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 39.45. The only query near the target band was two impressions for official jet-lag guidance at average position 8; the strongest relevant page test was two impressions for the contractor-estimate guide at position 8.5. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings.
searchConsole.decision: No query or page had enough repeatable evidence for a Data-led article. The report informed discovery work instead: the batch adds three non-overlapping intents, places each on its department hub and Library, adds twelve reciprocal contextual links, refreshes homepage discovery and regenerates the sitemap and manifest.
searchConsole.ignored: The two jet-lag-query impressions, two contractor-guide impressions, one charity-page impression at position 11 and six homepage impressions were deliberately ignored as too small or non-specific for topic selection, title rewriting or cluster expansion.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the beard-trimmer buying guide. The strength-progression record and cheese-board hosting plan remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready resistance-training program and progression record that separates goal, weekly exposure, per-exercise prescription, completed work, progression evidence, recovery response and professional-care stop rules, tied to the 2026 ACSM position stand and current federal activity guidance.
authority.cluster: Resistance-training programming and self-monitoring, with reciprocal paths from the established RPE/RIR, rest-period, warm-up and return-after-a-break guides; the beard-trimmer and cheese-board pages expand separate grooming-tool and hospitality clusters.
authority.opportunity: Three qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for the American College of Sports Medicine, HHS Move Your Way and the Partnership for Food Safety Education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Grooming, Fitness and Life: how to choose a beard trimmer that can reproduce a specific length and edge routine, how to turn a strength goal into a conservative evidence-based progression record, and how to host a cheese board with accurate labels, portions and food-safety controls. The beard-trimmer page serves purchase intent, the progression record is the authority asset, and the cheese-board plan explores a distinct hospitality problem. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
